records.title: Saudi pipeline outage threatens loss of 4% of global oil supply
records.claim: Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline remained offline after drone attacks; Reuters sources said Yanbu had roughly 5-7 days of stocks to maintain exports and up to 4% of global supply could be at risk if the pipeline did not restart.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Saudi pipeline outage threatens loss of 4% of global oil supply

records.boundary: The 5-7 day inventory estimate and potential 4% global-supply impact are based on industry sources; Saudi authorities had not provided a repair duration or confirmed quantified export losses.

records.title: New attacks in Hormuz and Saudi test nerves as war's spread worsens oil disruption
records.claim: A vessel was hit while transiting Hormuz and the Houthis had captured Perim Island in Bab el-Mandeb, while Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline was shut, increasing correlated risk across Gulf and Red Sea export routes.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: New attacks in Hormuz and Saudi test nerves as war's spread worsens oil disruption

records.boundary: Perim control and a single vessel attack do not by themselves prove a sustained commercial closure of Bab el-Mandeb or Hormuz; vessel flows and shipowner policies require separate verification.

records.title: Trump tells Ukraine's Zelenskiy to stop hitting Russian diesel
records.claim: Trump called on Ukraine to stop targeting Russian diesel infrastructure; Reuters reported that repeated Ukrainian drone attacks had reduced Russian fuel production and that U.S. average diesel prices had recently exceeded $6/gallon.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Trump tells Ukraine's Zelenskiy to stop hitting Russian diesel

records.boundary: The claim that Ukrainian strikes are causing the global diesel shortage is Trump's attribution; Reuters directly supports reduced Russian fuel production and the contemporaneous high U.S. diesel price, not a quantified global causal share.

records.title: How obscure yttrium became a global flashpoint
records.claim: Reuters commentary described China's dominant yttrium supply position, highly intermittent exports to the U.S., near-absence of supply to Japan since late 2025, and resulting impacts on aerospace, energy and semiconductor supply chains.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: How obscure yttrium became a global flashpoint

records.boundary: This source is Reuters Open Interest commentary, not straight news. Its factual trade-flow observations are usable, while the author's geopolitical interpretation is treated as analysis rather than established fact.

data_gaps: No accepted same-window complete JKM/TTF/CP-FEI/VLGC/LNGC, major crude benchmark, diesel crack-spread or war-risk surcharge series.
No official confirmed Saudi East-West pipeline restart time or same-window actual throughput.
No verified same-window consolidated commercial-vessel flow series for both Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb.
No same-window quantified Russian refined-product export loss attributable to refinery strikes.
No complete official yttrium mine/separation production series or current China quota disclosure.
